summary: The percent subject binder (_PERCENT_SUBJECT = r'\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z]{2,})\b', anchors.py:~635) treats ANY capitalized word after the % as the subject. It works on real proper nouns (France/Italy: 924/924 wrong-subject pairs held, 84/84 legit greens preserved) but greens clearly-unsupported claims whenever a capitalized COMMON word coincidentally appears in the source, blind to negation / polarity / concept-mismatch. This is why the council flipped NARROW -> BROAD: the subject-LABELED green path is not soundly bindable deterministically. Fix = scope percent out of deterministic affirmation entirely (mirror money/duration); affirm only via the AFM subject labeler (ADR-0013). PR #181 (subject-less scope-out only) does NOT close these.
